cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?
